    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Task_Confirm" targetRef="Task_Perform" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ok" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Success" targetRef="Task_Report" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_fail" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Success" targetRef="Task_Notify" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" sourceRef="Gw_End" targetRef="End_Done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
